label: gathering-shelter-concept-01-revised spatial option
rationale: The exact 6-by-4-cell footprint forms one rectangular, single-level walkable region with no projecting or detached cells. typology_hypothesis: A compact single-storey rectangular pavilion organized as one unobstructed shared room, with a sheltered doorway opening directly to the gathering area and built-in storage confined to the perimeter outside circulation.
